scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of asymptotic distribution and phase diagram supplied; finite numerical checks are corroborating diagnostics, not infinite certification; Gaussian maxima and spherical beta law acknowledged as classical.
scientific_limitations: Linear stationary isotropic independent-noise OU model only; polynomial number of independent real Haar directions; population moments conditional on sensors, not finite-sample detection or nonlinear tipping. Earlier equivalent applications of classical spherical extreme-value laws remain possible.
title: Sharp random-sensor threshold for a single slowing Ornstein–Uhlenbeck mode
